environment.description: Same Django 4.2 application on AWS ECS Fargate. The ALB has a CloudFront distribution in front with a Response Headers Policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03, 'SecurityHeadersPolicy') attached that injects Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self' on ALL responses regardless of origin response headers. Additionally, the ECS task role has a permission boundary that prevents modifying CloudFront distributions or response header policies (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/deny-cloudfront-mutation). The Django SecurityMiddleware is configured with SECURE_BROWSER_XSS_FILTER=True but this is separate from the CSP enforcement which occurs at the CDN edge layer.
